sections.hook: I didn't edit this video. I dropped a file in a folder. Claude did the rest.
sections.stakes: And it didn't use just one AI. Every task has its tool. Here are my six, from the reflex to avoid to my pick.
elements: To write the script. A blank page, you lose your evening. A regular chat, it gets you by. Me, I use Claude with a skill. It follows my method.
For the voice. On the mic, every mistake means another take. A standard voice, it's fine. Me, I use Eleven Labs. My cloned voice, the one you're hearing.
For the images. Stock photos, everyone has the same ones. A free generator, it gets you by. Me, I use Atlas Cloud. Images and video in the same place.
For the editing. By hand, you spend hours on it. A ready-made template, it's quick. Me, I use Remotion. The animation is written in code, timed to every word.
To publish. Network by network, it takes forever. Scheduling by hand, it's okay. Me, I use Blotato. Four networks, one single action.

And the sixth one is the one that changes everything: the conductor. Launching it all yourself wears you out. An n-eight-n workflow is very good. Me, I use Claude Code. Every night, it checks my folder.
sections.recap: It writes. It speaks. It draws. It edits. It publishes. It directs. Nothing by hand anymore. Just a folder.
sections.cta: Save this video, you're going to need it. Subscribe to get the guide, then click the link in bio, and type the keyword TOOLS.
sections.outro: And the next time you see a video like this, remember...
